verdict: One P2 evidence-identity validation gap remains open. Four production method paths and current recorded outputs are valid; API freeze/version changes have no new finding in this scope. Not final release approval.

findings.title: Verify source, recipe and task identities against the saved run
findings.details: verify trusts top-level source/runtime metadata and does not bind external recipe/task bytes to the saved run manifest and trace. Source revision/runtime replacement, a recipe budget change, and a task-question change all return success on copied metadata with original raw runs untouched.
findings.required_fix: Validate typed RunManifest internal hashes; external recipe and lock against manifest; source pins against top-level provenance and commit/runtime-tree identity; task dataset hashes and frozen original input/feedback against actual consumed records. Reject or explicitly bind dirty execution source.
findings.status: reported to secretary for consolidated repair
